obligations.note: The change sets payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES to 16 in policy.py and payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16 in policy-params.json. That breaks the catalog bound payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15, and no valid exception covers the deviation.

The cited EXC-0210 is scoped to component mortgage.session, not payments.session, and was requested by the change author himself. EXC-0141 does cover payments.session but expired on 2026-09-19, before the review time of 2026-10-19. Neither can excuse the deviation.
Ticket CHG-24034 was approved by change manager Erik Brandt at 2026-10-13T07:53Z, before the change opened. Its components (payments.policy, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
Mara Costa, a payments change_approver who is not the author, gave a code_review approval on the head commit.
Both approvals name the head commit 63831d6, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json reports success on the head commit from ci-runner-06. However, the only JUnit report is stamped 2026-10-23 from host dev-laptop-7.local, which is after the review time and not from the CI executor, so it cannot be tied to this run.
The touched components, payments.policy and payments.controls-data, are not security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
The protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json changed. Rachel Stein (control_owner, controls-office, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers policy.py's PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES or the session code. Covered symbols in payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and the mortgage files are unchanged.

summary: The change raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, which violates SES-1's approved bound of at most 15. The exception it cites, EXC-0210, is scoped to the Mortgage session component and was requested by the author. The only payments SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, has expired. The CI test report also cannot be tied to the recorded run. The change is rejected on SES-1 and EXC-1.
